page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon virtual CPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk I/O or hardware acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
